mapper.sql: select id, user_id, contact_name, contact_phone, region, location, geo, address_detail, doorplate, is_default, remark, create_time, update_time from user_service_address
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} order by is_default desc, update_time desc, id desc
where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1 order by update_time desc, id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_service_address ( id, user_id, contact_name, contact_phone, region, location, geo, address_detail, doorplate, is_default, remark, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{region}, #{location}, #{geo}, #{addressDetail}, #{doorplate}, #{isDefault}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: update user_service_address set contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, region = #{region}, location = #{location}, geo = #{geo}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, doorplate = #{doorplate}, is_default = #{isDefault}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
update user_service_address set is_default = 0, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1
